player_calibration.note: Floor-only manual-reference homography (image px -> court metres) for the RIGHT-HAND court. EXPORTED frame (court_xy_m, image_to_court_h, anchors): x 0..6.1 across (x=0 image-left outer edge), y=0 FAR end, y=13.4 NEAR camera-side end, net y=6.7. Correspondences use BWF 40 mm line CENTRES (e.g. near baseline 13.38, near long service 12.62, near short service 8.70, sidelines 0.02/0.48/5.62/6.08). checks.* are in the INTERNAL frame (y_internal = 13.4 - y_export). Line centres auto-refined from eye-placed seeds on a temporal-median background. All anchors lie in the near half: far-half positions are extrapolated (anchor_status +far_half_extrapolated; sensitivity grows to ~0.3 m in y near the far baseline). Not certified metric accuracy; not a 3D camera model. court_xy_m only from gated ankle anchors, never bbox bottoms.

shuttle_map_reference.method: conditional_ray_flight_fit_v4: metric camera P=[h1,h2,pZ,h3] from existing manual floor homography + 2 visually located net-post tops (Z=1.55 m); per uninterrupted 2D run, quadratic-drag ballistic ODE (g=9.81, drag k prior 0.21+-0.08 1/m) fitted to selected TrackNet pixels at actual PTS assuming real-time playback; estimated point = point on the observed pixel ray nearest the fitted model at that PTS. Depth comes from gravity curvature + drag prior, NOT from any observed height; height priors do not dominate accepted runs (no contact/height prior used) but depth is model-conditional.
shuttle_map_reference.note: Display-only conditional estimate. NOT a measurement, NOT the strict shuttle_model_xyz_m layer (which stays null; flights stays []). interpolated = model prediction inside an accepted flight (flight_id set) or linear xyz interpolation between computed seeds across contacts/unsupported frames (flight_id null); reference = nearest within-segment seed held with its original timestamp.
assumptions: Floor homography (players-court-v3 manual reference) is correct; its right-side singles line shows up to 0.45 m held-out deviation.
Net-post top pixels (333,997) and (942.5,998) are the pole tops on the doubles sidelines x=0 and x=6.1 at y=6.7, height 1.55 m; located by eye, +-3 px.
Camera static for all 210 frames (as in v3).
Clip plays in real time (29.97 fps PTS = physical time); gravity 9.81 m/s^2 sets metric depth.
Shuttle obeys quadratic drag dV/dt=-k|V|V-g with k prior 0.21+-0.08 1/m (typical feather/nylon shuttle, terminal ~6.8 m/s); not measured for this shuttle.
Each accepted run is one uninterrupted flight (no contact inside); contacts lie in gaps between runs; contact timing/height NOT reviewed (hypothesis only).
TrackNet selected pixels (v3 shuttle_observed_px) are the shuttle; runs with <8 samples rejected.
